name: own7-research-dashboard
description: Static, source-backed NBA research dashboard; no wagering execution

scripts.build: python -m nba_lab run && python -m nfl_lab run && python scripts/build_site.py
scripts.check: python -m unittest discover -s tests && python -m nfl_lab run --check && python nfl/test_build.py && python scripts/check_site.py
